description: List applications to your listings, newest first: candidate name and headline, status, match score, whether it was read, and the ATS state when the listing is connected to Greenhouse or Lever. Use get_application for the resume, cover letter and conversation. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

job_id.description: One listing (from list_my_listings). Omit for every listing you manage.

name: list_applications
